facts.fact: 叙述者（年轻女性，随身挎包）未及换气便被水整个包围、衣裙湿透下坠——本章以没入水中完成向异界的转场。
facts.quote: Before my next breath, I was surrounded by water.

facts.fact: 她扯掉外裙与上衣（blouse）拼命上浮，冲破水面爬向岸边。
facts.quote: I tore my outer skirts and blouse away, desperate to pierce the surface.

facts.fact: 她双手抓进岸边的草里，把自己从水中拖上岸，仰面瘫倒仰望天空。
facts.quote: I balled my fists into it, pulling myself from the water.

facts.fact: 她倒空挎包清点湿物：湿书、手持相机、橡皮、一支半铅笔（one and a half pencils，逐字）、围巾与项链。
facts.quote: Wet books, a handheld camera, an eraser, one and a half pencils

facts.fact: 人物关系：她跪地翻找的是父亲的日志（father’s journal）——书页从书脊脱开、墨水洇透，日志已毁不可救。
facts.quote: “No . . .” I dropped to my knees, shuffling through the items for my father’s journal.

facts.fact: 魔法书 grimoire（文中称有知觉之物 sentient object）滴水未沾、干得彻底，页面疏水、水珠直接滚落。
facts.quote: The pages were hydrophobic. The beads of water rolled right off.

facts.fact: 她透过相机取景器看见全彩光环交织；镜下证实身旁的「花」实为漆黑之物——是 Peculiar（异怪），根本不是花。
facts.quote: I pointed the lens at the flowers beside me, which were revealed to be pitch black.

facts.fact: 关键转折：她确认自己终于抵达 Otherside（异侧/彼岸）——但接下来该去哪里仍是谜。
facts.quote: Finally, I was on the Otherside.
